description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewSaveController class, which extends an abstract controller to manage the rendering of performance review components (either 'edit-review' or 'add-review') in the OrangeHRM system. It handles pre-render logic based on request attributes.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewSaveController
classes.description: Controller handling the pre-render process for performance review forms, deciding whether to display an 'edit' or 'add' review component based on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook that sets up the review component depending on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request, indicating an edit or add operation.
